text: Bajaj Finance Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of QIP 2026 - Special Committee meeting
nse_summary: Bajaj Finance Limited opened a Qualified Institutions Placement on November 11, 2026. The Board approved the issue following shareholder approval via special resolution on November 2, 2026. The floor price is set at Rs. 992.25 per equity share. This price is based on the relevant date of November 11, 2026. The company may offer a discount of up to 5% on this floor price. The final issue price will be determined by the company in consultation with book running lead managers. A preliminary placement document dated November 11, 2026, was approved. This document and application forms are being sent to eligible qualified institutional buyers. The QIP Committee meeting concluded at 4.30 p.m. on November 11, 2026. The preliminary placement document will be filed with the BSE and NSE on November 11, 2026.
